entries.zh: 钟表目录宣传了一款面向产业工人的防磁手表。

entries.en: The simulation plots the antimeson's path across the detector.
entries.zh: 模拟绘出了反介子穿过探测器的路径。

entries.en: The interior design leaves a wide path between the tables.
entries.zh: 室内设计在桌子之间留出了一条宽敞通道。

entries.en: The stylist shaped a finger wave along the model's forehead.
entries.zh: 发型师沿着模特的额头做出了手指卷发。

entries.en: The child cut a tiny coat to fit her paper doll.
entries.zh: 孩子剪了一件适合她的纸制人形玩具的小外套。

entries.en: The geometry program rotates an ellipse to construct an ellipsoid of revolution.
entries.zh: 几何程序旋转一个椭圆，构建出回转椭球。

entries.en: We were stuck with the broken van until the mechanic arrived.
entries.zh: 机械师到来前，我们只能守着坏掉的货车，无法脱身。

entries.en: The football coach gathered the players beside the goal before training.
entries.zh: 训练前，足球教练将球员召集到球门旁。

entries.en: The archived drug index lists the antimetabolite under its chemical name.
entries.zh: 存档药物索引按化学名称收录了这种抗代谢物。

entries.en: The laboratory report compares the materials' antimicrobic properties.
entries.zh: 实验室报告比较了这些材料的抗微生物性质。

entries.en: The museum labels the historical preparation as an antimonial compound.
entries.zh: 博物馆将这种历史制剂标为含锑化合物。

entries.en: The survey covered a geographic area stretching from the river to the hills.
entries.zh: 调查覆盖了从河流延伸到群山的一片地理区域。

entries.en: The technician placed the beaker on a hot plate.
entries.zh: 技术员把烧杯放在电热板上。

entries.en: She wore a feathered picture hat to the garden party.
entries.zh: 她戴着一顶羽毛装饰的女用阔边帽参加了花园聚会。

entries.en: The archive photograph shows workers standing beside an oil well.
entries.zh: 档案照片中，工人们站在一口油井旁。

entries.en: The detective noticed the card sharp hiding an ace in his sleeve.
entries.zh: 侦探注意到那个耍老千的人把一张A牌藏进了袖子。

entries.en: The beauty shop closed early while its windows were replaced.
entries.zh: 美容院在更换窗户期间提前关门了。

entries.en: The editor updated the master file before making the printed copies.
entries.zh: 编辑在制作印刷副本前更新了主文件。

entries.en: The old chemical register lists several antimonic salts.
entries.zh: 旧化学登记册列出了几种锑盐。

entries.en: The chemistry exercise asks students to compare antimonious and antimonic compounds.
entries.zh: 化学习题要求学生比较三价锑化合物与锑的较高价态化合物。

entries.en: The history essay examines antimonopoly legislation and its political opponents.
entries.zh: 历史论文分析了反垄断立法及其政治反对者。

entries.en: The postal museum traces the expansion of rural free delivery through old route maps.
entries.zh: 邮政博物馆通过旧路线图追溯了乡村地区免费邮递服务的扩展。

entries.en: The rescue operation resumed when the helicopter returned with extra fuel.
entries.zh: 直升机带着额外燃料返回后，营救行动重新开始。

entries.en: The vessel sailed with its full complement of officers and crew.
entries.zh: 这艘船在高级船员和普通船员全部到齐后出航了。

entries.en: The orchard will yield fruit in due season if the young trees survive.
entries.zh: 如果幼树成活，果园将在适当的时候结果。

entries.en: She was so taken with the little cottage that she sketched it twice.
entries.zh: 她被这座小别墅迷住了，给它画了两次素描。

entries.en: The retired workers laughed as they recalled the good old days.
entries.zh: 退休工人们回忆过去美好的日子时笑了起来。

entries.en: The physics diagram distinguishes the antimuon track from the electron track.
entries.zh: 物理示意图区分了反μ子轨迹和电子轨迹。

entries.en: The archived laboratory notebook records experiments involving antimycin.
entries.zh: 存档实验室笔记记录了涉及抗霉素的实验。

entries.en: The historical review compares the reported effects of antineoplastic preparations.
entries.zh: 这篇历史综述比较了文中报告的抗肿瘤制剂的作用。

entries.en: The teacher circled an eye rhyme at the ends of two lines.
entries.zh: 老师圈出了两行诗末尾的一处视觉韵。

entries.en: The neighbours settled the dispute before the civil suit reached trial.
entries.zh: 在民事诉讼开庭审理前，邻居们解决了争端。

entries.en: The student teacher prepared the lesson with help from her supervisor.
entries.zh: 实习教师在指导教师的帮助下准备了这堂课。

entries.en: The exhibition traces changes in the automobile industry through factory photographs.
entries.zh: 展览通过工厂照片追溯了汽车工业的变迁。

entries.en: The supporters arrived early for the team's first home game.
entries.zh: 球迷们为球队的首场主场比赛提前到场。

entries.en: The sound engineer stored the master copy separately from the listening versions.
entries.zh: 音响工程师把原本与供收听的版本分开存放。

entries.en: The organisation changed its domain name after the merger.
entries.zh: 这个组织在合并后更换了域名。
